title: Lack of `isLpCreated` validation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The lack of `isLpCreated` variable validation in the `ContinuosBondingERC20Token` contract functions makes it possible to return the bonding token to the purchase phase. This can cause unexpected behavior such as secondary involving `_createPair` or withdrawing treasury fees but it is almost always economically inefficient.
